title: Service Road Marker 6-B Replacement Request
abstract: Disposition of a facilities request to replace marker 6-B during the Bellwether monitoring period.
subject: Service Road Marker 6-B Replacement Request

body.text: The request to replace marker post 6-B is denied while quarterly monitoring remains active. The post is structurally serviceable, carries the original evidence seal, and defines one endpoint of the established survey baseline. Surface fading does not prevent identification at ordinary road speed.

Facilities cited three reports that two 6-B markers were visible at the same time. Replacing the confirmed post would not resolve those reports because no second physical post has been located, inventoried, or made available for removal. A work order cannot be issued for an item that is present only while the observer is in motion.

body.label: Temporary maintenance authorization
body.text: Facilities may clean the existing post by hand between 10:00 and 14:00. Do not detach it, obscure the evidence seal, or arrive with a second replacement post in the service vehicle.

This denial is not a finding that the duplicate-marker reports are accurate. It preserves the only endpoint whose location and chain of custody are not disputed. Submit ordinary vegetation-clearance costs under the reservoir maintenance code rather than the investigative travel code.
